def turan_edges(m, omega):
    q = m // omega
    r = m % omega
    # Turan graph T(m, omega) has r parts of size q+1 and (omega-r) parts of size q
    # Number of edges is m(m-1)/2 - sum(n_i * (n_i - 1) / 2)
    sum_ni_choose_2 = r * (q + 1) * q // 2 + (omega - r) * q * (q - 1) // 2
    return m * (m - 1) // 2 - sum_ni_choose_2

m = 1000
omega = 143
print(f"Turan edges for m={m}, omega={omega}: {turan_edges(m, omega)}")
